section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1971
title: 10 *Population of the cities is actual as on 1st April, 1971. Table 5 indicates the distribution of accidental deaths by sex in different States, Union Territories and Cities. On an average, 64·7% of the persons who were involved in accidental deaths were Males. A similar pattern has been observed in almost all the States excepting Himachal Pradesh, Manipur, Nagaland, Punjab and Uttar Pradesh where it was much more than the All-India average, the respective percentage being 80·0%, 92·5%, 100·0%, 84·5% and 71·1%. Among the Union Territories the over-all percentage of male involvement was 79·4%. Among the Cities, Bombay, Calcutta, Delhi and Kanpur indicated higher percentage of male involvement in accidental deaths as compared to the All-India average, the highest percentage being in Calcutta (83·1) followed by Delhi (75·7).
